Header: Peronospora sparsa Sinhala –“Yati pus”; Tamil-“Keel poonchanam”)

Prevention: Maintain proper spacing (20 x 20 cm) between plants
Prune excess foliage but do not prune during wet weather
Protect plants from heavy rain (use rain shelter)
Keep the field weed free' Use synthetic mulch
Use fungicides (see yellow direct control) as a preventive measure during wet weather conditions
Monitoring: Look for angular tan spots near the midrib of leaflets
Leaves turn reddish yellow and drop
Collapsing of buds and cankers on newly emerged rose canes
Direct Control: Remove diseased and fallen leaves and burn
Remove dead or dying canes and burn
Rate of dilution- 50 g/ 1 lit. of water.
Restrictions: Always wear personal protective equipment while handling pesticides.
Read the manufacturer’s instructions carefully before handling pesticides.
Do not eat, smoke or drink while spraying pesticides.
Do not repeat pesticides with same mode of action.
FRAC – Fungicide resistant action committee -Mode of action.
Rate of dilution- 30 ml/10 lit. of water.
Toxic to predatory mites, earthworms and fish
Toxic to predatory mites, parasitoids and fish and moderately toxic to flower bugs
Rate of dilution– 10 ml/10 lit. of water.
